entry.author: Eastern Institute Of Technology
entry.summary:
Can tech help create a more sustainable future?

Our Bachelor of Computing Systems students recently presented their EIT Energy Saver project at Muriwai Marae, developing real-world technology solutions to support smarter energy use and more sustainable living.

Working alongside the marae, students applied their computing skills to explore practical ways to reduce energy consumption, improve resource efficiency, and create solutions with lasting community impact.

This is what studying computing at EIT is all about: solving real problems, working with industry and community partners, and building technology that makes a difference.
Interested in a career in tech? Enrol in the Bachelor of Computing Systems at EIT and start building the future.
